entries.description: A lesbian separatist homestead on 45 acres, home to 3 lesbians. Focuses on farming, self-sufficiency, herbal and psychic healing workshops, and providing safe space for women.
entries.raw_text: ROWDYBUSH FARM (Susun Weed & Clove), 3136 Fishcreek Rd, Saugerties, NY 12477. Our dream is to be part of a network of SAFE SPACES for wimmin. Right now we are a hard working lesbian separatist homestead on an old blue stone quarry with a lovely, secluded pond. We provide almost all our own food with three large gardens, a solar greenhouse, dairy goats, chickens, ducks and fruit trees (to be planted this spring). We support the land partly by working outside jobs and partly by holding Herbal and Psychic Healing Intensives every summer. We are working on wheelchair accessibility for house and campsites. We welcome lesbians of all ages as visitors for up to five days, $2-5/day donation. We have/are: 3 lesbians, 45 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, wimmin living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative as they describe themselves as a 'homestead' with multiple lesbians living and working there. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (welcomes 'lesbians of all ages', 3 lesbians living). Focuses: Lesbian separatism ('lesbian separatist homestead'), Spirituality/ritual ('Psychic Healing Intensives'), Farming/self-sufficiency ('provide almost all our own food'), Workshops/education ('Herbal and Psychic Healing Intensives'). Mailing address is a road address, so used as land address.

entries.description: Womyn's land on 150 acres, focusing on farming, self-sufficiency, and gardening. Welcomes visitors, new members, and girl children.
entries.raw_text: NORTHWOODS RD 1 Box 156, Alpine, NY 14805 (607)594-3536. (Between Ithaca & Watkins Glen, NY.) Northwoods is in its 6th year as womyn's land, now moving this spring to a more focused use of the land than just gardening and living. We're investing in farm equipment and need work energy. Healing is a focus of many of us. We need everyone here to be self sufficient and self motivated. We welcome: visitors (maybe), new members (perhaps, cautiously), girl children. We have/are: 6-10 lesbians, 150 acreage, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative as it is established 'womyn's land' with multiple residents and seeking new members. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (implied by directory and text '6-10 lesbians'), Non-lesbian women ('We welcome: visitors... new members', without restriction to lesbians), Girl children ('girl children'). Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency ('self sufficient', 'farm equipment'). Rural route address used for land address. Acreage given as 150.

entries.description: A womyn's homestead on 25 acres in West Virginia, owned and run by 2 lesbians. Teaches skills to apprentices and welcomes visitors to help.
entries.raw_text: MISTY BOTTOMS FARM c/o Mimi & Judy, Rt 86 Box 15A, Jumping Branch, WV 25969. We are building a womyn's homestead on 25 acres in a hollow on a creek in the mountains of WV. Secluded land, access by foot or 4-wheel drive. We are carpenters and woodworker/blacksmith as well as farmers. Will teach skills to serious apprentices. Visitors welcome and expected to help (bring own food). We welcome: girl children and apprentices. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 25 acres, housing/permanent structure, electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('c/o Mimi & Judy', '2 lesbians', and not actively recruiting residents to join the ownership/collective). Accepted groups: Lesbian women (directory context), Non-lesbian women ('apprentices', visitors without lesbian restriction), Girl children ('girl children'). Focuses: Workshops/education ('Will teach skills to serious apprentices'), Farming/self-sufficiency ('homestead... farmers'). Rural route used as land address.

entries.description: A collective of seven wimmin on 40 acres in Mississippi. Not separatists; spiritual, artistic, scientific, and political. Welcomes women, children, and men (dogs on leash).
entries.raw_text: SILVER CIRCLE FARM c/o Gwen O Demeter, Box 100 Rt 5, Holly Springs, MS 38635. We are a collective of seven wimmin dedicated to caring for 40 acres and each other. We strive to tolerate our differences as well as enjoy them. We are striving toward self sufficiency. Visits require work exchange and/or cash for short stays. Longer visits/meals negotiable. Have communal kitchen. We are not separatists. We are spiritual, artistic, scientific, political, but most important we are loving wimmin trying to give each other space to grow! We welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, dogs (but only on leash). We have/are: 7 lesbians, 40 acres, permanent structures (in process), outdoor plumbing, electricity (also hook-ups for couple of RV's), camping space, woods, farm land, wimmin living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('collective of seven wimmin'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women (directory context, '7 lesbians'), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children ('girl... children'), Boy children ('boy children'), Gay men and Non-gay men (implicitly allowed as they are 'not separatists' and welcome 'nonlesbian women' and families, though no men explicitly named except general family context—wait, rule says: males not coded unless named. Let's recheck rule: 'In the 1982 directory, males are not coded unless the listing names them'. This is 1983, but does it name men? It says 'girl and boy children, nonlesbian women'. It does not explicitly name adult men, so do not code men. Let's code: Lesbian women, Non-lesbian women, Girl children, Boy children). Focuses: Spirituality/ritual ('spiritual'), Farming/self-sufficiency ('self sufficiency', 'farm land'). Rural route used as land address.

entries.description: A family of 6 lesbians (4 on the land) developing a self-sufficient space on 18 acres in Texas. Focuses on farming, workshops, and a drug-free environment.
entries.raw_text: EARTH CURRENT FARM Rt 1 Box 137L, Red Rock, TX 78662 (512)764-2706. We are a family of 6 lesbians, 4 on the land. We are developing a self sufficient space 35 miles SE of Austin, that will provide most of our food and bring in at least part of our survival money. Our plans include chickens, goats, sheep, rabbits, a garden, orchard, and a stain-glass and spinning workshop. We welcome: girl children and dogs (maybe leashed). Visits limited to 2-3 days, $2 per person or work exchange, no drugs, alcohol or cigarettes please. We have/are: 6 lesbians, 18 and a half [sic - 18] acres, 2 housing/permanent structures, electricity, camping space, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('family of 6 lesbians... developing a self sufficient space'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women (directory context), Girl children ('girl children'). Focuses: Recovery/substance-free ('no drugs, alcohol or cigarettes please'), Farming/self-sufficiency ('self sufficient', 'provide most of our food', 'chickens, goats... garden, orchard'), Archives/cultural work ('stain-glass and spinning workshop'). Rural route used as land address. Num residents: 4 ('4 on the land'). Acreage: 18.

entries.description: A couple in their 40s living on 13 forested acres in California, seeking 1-3 semi-collective members. Substance-free, near Yuba River.
entries.raw_text: CEDAR c/o Linda or Sara, PO Box 274, Camptonville, CA 95922. We are a couple in our 40's, vegies/non-smokers, living on 13 acres, deeply forested, sub-alpine beauty at 3200'. Looking for 1-3 semi-collective members, very hard to make a living locally, rural, quite isolated, wet winters, hot summers, near incredible Yuba River, other parcels for sale nearby and looking for lesbian buyers. We welcome: new members, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 13 acres, trailer, shed, electricity/well, camping space, woods, organic garden/ orchard, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because although it starts with a couple (normally Private/Individual Land), they are actively seeking '1-3 semi-collective members' to join them living on the land. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (directory context), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children ('girl... children'), Boy children ('boy children'). Focuses: Recovery/substance-free ('non-smokers', vegies/non-smokers rule, wait, 'vegies/non-smokers' refers to diet/tobacco, let's check rule: 'A ban on smoking tobacco alone is not enough' for recovery/substance-free. So do not code recovery for tobacco/vegies unless drugs/alcohol mentioned. No drugs/alcohol mentioned, so no recovery focus). Farming/self-sufficiency ('organic garden/ orchard'). Mailing address is PO Box, so land street address and zip left blank; land city is Camptonville from mailing address and context.
